parties.petitioner: (None, case is State of Rajasthan as Appellant)

summary: Chronic service irregularities leading to departmental action; 16 charges including unauthorized construction permits, illegal shop sales below market value, embezzlement of cooperative society funds (Rs.9,025/- stamps, Rs.4,000/- fake cash entries), retention of rent proceeds without clearance; multiple failed reinstatement attempts post-suspension in 1979; dismissal upheld after prolonged proceedings spanning four decades; charges proved beyond reasonable doubt; DPC rightly deemed unfit for promotion during pendency of enquiry; retrospective removal order quashed but reconfirmed after procedural compliance; High Court's interference in departmental discretion set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Rajasthan Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 1958 Rule 16
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; removal from service reinstated; costs awarded to appellants.
